# Grok Build (xAI)

A coding agent that runs on your machine: it reads the repo, edits files and runs commands itself. Best for `build` and `fix`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Local agent (`grok`) |
| conductor name | `grok-cli` |
| Docs | https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build |

## Set up

1. Install:
   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```
2. Sign in once: `grok login   (or set XAI_API_KEY from console.x.ai)`
3. Enable `grok-cli` in `conductor ui` → Providers (or run `conductor setup`, which finds installed agents), then check it:
   ```bash
   conductor doctor --live
   ```

## What it may do under conductor

- **Write roles:** OS sandbox (strict): writes only in the project and temp, no network for commands on Linux; git push/commit/reset and sudo denied; web tools off
- **Read roles:** OS sandbox (read-only) and only its read, grep and list tools

conductor passes these rules on the command line for each run; your own settings for the CLI are not changed. Details: [Providers → Permissions](../PROVIDERS.md#permissions-what-each-agent-may-do).
